scope: Source contracts, mechanical diffs and XML/permission review. No compiler, policy compiler, build, CI, ADB or runtime test.
remaining: New commits require a server rebuild.
CPU/GPU sysfs labels, DAC ownership and writes require runtime verification.
AppArmor and XFRM_USER_COMPAT have dormant private kvmalloc names; this audit does not validate enabling additional kernel configurations.
BPF feature-version override is not proof of complete Linux 5.4 API coverage.
Boot, Wi-Fi cold/warm reboot, encryption and hardware still require device testing.
